content:
When you have a DNS threat detector (/dns/docs/threat-detection) monitoring your VPC network,
the detector exports metrics that can be examined with Cloud Monitoring.
There are two types of metrics available:
networksecurity.googleapis.com/dnsthreatdetector/sent_dns_log_count: DNS
query logs that are sent to your provider for inspection.
networksecurity.googleapis.com/dnsthreatdetector/received_dns_threat_coun
t: The number of threat logs detected. This metric includes severity and the type of
threat.
